That's too bad. .\_. Would it be possible to define the sorting manually, though? Aside from the 4 options (count|isRefined|name:asc|name:desc)? I need this sorting: Fachbereich / Zentren / Experten / Sprechstunden

I had my PHP indexer run in this order, but as soon as the items are imported, Algolia just ignores this order.
